    CloseObject('Fridge')

    GoToObject('KeyChain')
    # 2: Pick up the KeyChain.
    PickupObject('KeyChain')

    GoToObject('Wallet')

    PickupObject('Phone')

    GoToObject('Door')

    robot.GoToObject('Bread')

    robot.PutObject('Bread', 'Toaster')

    robot.GoToObject('Fridge')
